package.description: Highlight parts of the screen by partially hiding unneeded parts

en-US.description: Highlight parts of the screen by partially hiding unneeded parts
en-US.longDescription:
Screen Highlighter - Highlight parts of the screen
Screen Highlighter allows to highlight a part of the screen by partially hiding the other parts. A horizontal bar is visible and the rest is partially hidden.
